restrictions: Fixed-IV SHA-256, first 40 steps, standard padding and feed-forward, equality of all 256 output bits; one 64-byte data block per message from the standard IV, followed by the common SHA-256 padding block (equal inputs give the equal padding block, so a first-data-block collision is a full-message collision).

Prices: one 40-step target compression is one unit; every other primitive word operation is 1/C with C = 2896. Verifying a found pair is 4 reduced compressions (the data block and the padding block of each of the two messages), charged as one unit each (4 units per found pair), separately from the word operations.

Head (proof Section 2): the shipped program (bit-sliced, 256 lanes; one gate on 256 lanes = one word operation, as in our round-40 entry df1f1cd1; per-lane accounting would add exactly 8 bits). Per kept pair 40,513.2 charged operations = (10,118.182 word ops per kept pair = (40,000 generation budget + 256 x 6,800 per-lane work of every lane) / 176) x 4 loads/stores = 40,472.7, x 1/(1 - 0.001) for discarded batches; 2^3.80626 units. Generation = the declared budget 40,000 word ops per batch (enforced by the program; measured 38,064-38,758) / kept floor 176 of 256. The whole per-lane block (6,675 primitives itemized in proof Section 2) is charged 6,800 per lane inside ops_used. A batch halting at the budget or keeping fewer than 176 lanes is discarded and still charged; discard fraction at most 0.001 declared (measured 1 of 40,000; premise H-kept-pair-yield). Pair output with 4 reduced verification compressions.

Landing and tail (proof Section 3): the J26 difference lands on the target with probability 2^-256 per pair (premise P1, a declared heuristic: the exact full-width rate is the premise, measured jointly to 32 bits and consistent, not a measured fact); from the target the pair collides after step 40 with probability 1 (premise P2, by construction: the schedule difference is silent on the words after the junction and the target cancels the step-26 word difference, so the two computations coincide from the junction on; 5000/5000 forced-target implementation check, negative control 0/2000).

Ledger: N = ln(1/0.61) x 2^256 pairs; T = B x (40,000 + 256 x 6,800) x 4 + 4 + 2^28.21 with the FIXED batch count B = ceil(N / (176 x (1 - 0.001))), N = ln(1/0.61) x 2^256: a deterministic total-work bound (every batch charged at the generation budget plus the per-lane block for all 256 lanes, kept or not, discarded or not); per kept pair this is 40,513.2 charged operations = 2^3.80626 units; the run stops at the first found pair (4 reduced compressions); log2 T = 258.78971; the success probability 0.39 includes the chance that more than a 0.001 fraction of the B batches is discarded, bounded by a Chernoff tail below 2^-1000 at the declared per-batch discard probability p <= 2e-4 (measured 1 of 40,000; Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 1.19e-4); log2 T = 258.78971 (exact 258.78970805, rounded up to five decimals).

Memory by construction (complete under the model): list subsets 357,408 + program code 47,117 + 256-lane sliced working state 112,640 (110 sliced words of 1,024 bytes) + word-level working state 928 + current messages 128 = 518,221 bytes (2^18.99, rounded up; term max(0, log2-20) = 0). Preprocessing: 7 list enumerations of 2^32 candidates at <= 24 word operations each = 7 x 2^25.09 compressions, plus 422 subset-selection compressions = 2^27.89; declared 2^28.21 (rounded up; proof Section 5 table) + 422 compressions of subset selection; the per-pair random word draws are charged as word operations.
Premises P1, P2, P3 (independence across pairs) are declared heuristics of the exploratory lane (proof Section 6).

heuristics.statement: For pairs output by the shipped program, the 256-bit J26 XOR difference equals the J26 target with probability 2^-256 per pair.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's pairs, standard IV, 40 steps. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma on every trial and fails the trial otherwise). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured k-bit landing on 2^36 head-induced states: 2^-8.00, 2^-16.00, 2^-23.98, 2^-31.83 for k = 8, 16, 24, 32; per-bit |p-0.5| <= 0.00001; extended to 256 bits under independence of bits. The shipped program over 20,000 organizer-format trials (4,331,098 pairs): k=8 landing 16,883 (expected 16,918.4), k=16 landing 82 (expected 66.1); per-trial k=8 dispersion chi-square 20,067 vs 19,999 +- 200. Organizer-run evidence: every trial of experiment v40-headtail-01 reports landing_k8, landing_k16, landing_k24, landing_k32 and best_lead_bits for its kept pairs; the expected counts are kept x 2^-k, and the per-trial landing_k8 counts give the dispersion test for P3. Program checks on 20,000 further fresh-seed trials (second machine): per-bit junction uniformity within 6 sigma on every trial (bit-match counts 70..151 of about 216), 0 tail or control failures; landing k8 17,034 (expected 16,915), k16 62 (66), k24 1 (0.26), k32 0 (0.001).
heuristics.limitations: Joint landing measured to 32 bits; the step to all 256 bits is the declared premise itself, not a derived bound. The v5 word-level generator is a cross-check only; the shipped program is v7/v7e.

heuristics.statement: A pair from the shipped program whose J26 difference equals the target collides after step 40 with probability 1.
heuristics.scope: the shipped program's pairs at the J26 target. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma on every trial and fails the trial otherwise). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: By construction: the schedule difference is silent on the words after the junction and the J26 target cancels the step-26 word difference, so from the junction on the two computations coincide and the pair collides. Implementation check: 5000/5000 with the target forced on real program states; negative control 0/2000.
heuristics.limitations: The implementation check uses forced-target states; the probability-1 claim rests on the structural argument.

heuristics.statement: Landing events of distinct pairs are independent.
heuristics.scope: pairs within and across shared batches. Tested regime: organizer seeds, 256 lanes per trial, landing checked jointly to 32 bits and per bit (the program asserts per-bit uniformity of the junction difference within 6 sigma on every trial and fails the trial otherwise). Extrapolated regime: the exact 256-bit event over ~2^255 pairs. Score sensitivity: a per-bit landing rate 2^-(1+e) instead of 2^-1 changes log2 T by 256e.
heuristics.extrapolation: k=4 landing correlation within batches -0.0009, across -0.0010, noise 0.0022 (8,192 pairs; 64-batch table in evidence). v7c (batch shares steps 0..12): chi-square independence test 259.3 vs 256 +- 22.6 (control 252.4), research junc7c.py. Over-dispersion test (research junc7c.py --k8): 64 batches x 512 pairs, per-batch k=8 J26 landing counts mean 2.094 (expected 2.000), variance 2.055 (Poisson 2.000), dispersion chi-square 65.0 on 64 batches (expected 64 +- 11.3): landings are Poisson across batches, no within-batch clustering. v7e (W13 = r + k x 6A09E667 per lane): GPU dispersion test vp7gpu.cu on 2^24-2^25 pairs per run, k=8 dispersion -0.52 sigma; all modes and seeds within +-2.2 sigma (research). Organizer-run evidence: the per-trial landing_k8 counts in the trusted report (each trial = one batch of 256 lanes) are the dispersion sample; under P3 their variance equals their mean.
heuristics.limitations: Tested on the landing indicators the program reports (to 32 bits); independence of the exact 256-bit event over the full run is the declared premise.

heuristics.statement: Each batch of 256 lanes keeps each lane with probability 0.846 (measured); a batch is discarded, and still charged, if it keeps fewer than 176 lanes or halts at the declared generation budget of 40,000 word operations; the fraction of discarded batches over the run is at most 0.001 (declared). Lane-keeping indicators within a batch are modelled as independent Bernoulli(0.846) (declared; measured kept-per-batch variance 33.27 vs binomial 33.37, ratio 0.997).
heuristics.scope: the shipped program, standard IV, 40 steps, every batch of the run
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured over 40,000 organizer-format fresh-seed batches on two machines: kept per batch mean 216.5, minimum 186; generation 38,064-38,758 word operations per batch; discarded batches: 1 of 20,000 (a budget halt at the old budget 38,758) and 0 of 20,000; none under the floor. With B about 2^247 batches and a declared per-batch discard probability p <= 2e-4 (above the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 1.19e-4 of the measured 1 in 40,000; every hard-check failure of a batch is a discard and is in the measured count), the probability that more than 0.001 B batches are discarded is below exp(-B x D(0.001 || 2e-4)) < 2^-1000, so the fixed batch count B suffices with the stated success probability. The organizer report lists kept, ops_used, checks_failed and checks_mask for every trial.
heuristics.limitations: The per-lane rate, the independence model and the discard probability bound p <= 2e-4 (measured 1 of 40,000, Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 1.19e-4) are declared; the budget and the floor are enforced by the program (a violating batch fails its trial); the Chernoff bound assumes independent batches (fresh organizer seeds per trial).
